about_the_game:
Your Road Through the Eternal Darkness

ZEROAD is an intense co-op side-scrolling shooter where you fight your way through hordes of the undead. Play solo or team up with friends—every run down a "Road" is a struggle for resources and a test of your skills. Your goal is to push through to the end, grabbing everything you need to return, re-arm, and prepare for the next, even more dangerous Road.

Forge Your Arsenal

Six classes of realistic weaponry—from pistols to machine guns—open the path to dozens of unique models you will craft and test in combat. Level up your character to unlock new firearms, and upgrade your weapons to make your survivor even more powerful and lethal.

Experience Every "Road"

Each new "Road" is a true test of endurance: new, increasingly stronger, faster, and more vicious enemies await. But so do more valuable rewards. The further you progress, the harder and more intense the missions become. Conquer all 25 Roads and encounter all 40 distinct types of zombies. They will not let you rest.

Leverage Team Tactics

Co-op in ZEROAD isn't just multiple players on one screen. It's about tactical interplay where your decisions determine if the group makes it to the very end: coordinate your attacks and watch each other's backs.

ZEROAD is a shooter where your progress is felt with every new gun in your arsenal, with every kilometer of the Road behind you, and with every new level your character gains. How many Roads can you conquer?

content_descriptors.notes: The content can be considered mature because the game's core mechanics revolve around killing enemies with guns. The art style is unrealistic, and the gore is stylized and unrealistic.

short_description: How many Roads can you conquer? Fight your way through hordes of the dead, honing your skills and scavenging valuable resources for crafting. Unleash a storm of lead with your crew or tear through the darkness alone. This is your road. This is ZEROAD.
